title: AfyaPlus data inventory (triage API + logistics MCP server), Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 alignment
controller: BenkiYetu (operator of the AfyaPlus deployment), teaching scenario
legal_status: TEACHING ARTEFACT. Section references are for orientation only and every lawful_basis value is a teaching label. Legal review pending: no lawyer or Data Protection Officer has reviewed this file.

regulator.name: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), Kenya
regulator.registration: NOT REGISTERED. This teaching deployment holds no ODPC registration, certificate or approval number, and none is claimed anywhere in this repository.
regulator.dpia: Not done. Processing health data at scale is the kind of processing the Act expects a DPIA for (s.31). A DPIA is an open action in manager_brief.md.

categories.what: Free-text symptom description typed by a CHW, plus patient_age_years and county
categories.sensitive: yes: health data, a sensitive category under the Act (s.2 definitions, s.44 to s.46)
categories.purpose: Decide the urgency of a household case and the next action; sample for clinical quality review
categories.lawful_basis_teaching_label: TEACHING LABEL (legal review pending): public-interest community health task, with the household's informed agreement at the visit

where.note: prompt_app.py does not write message text to any file or database

where.persisted: per the provider's API data-retention terms (verify before go-live)
where.note: ONLY when MODEL_BACKEND=openai. The replay and rules backends send nothing out. This is a cross-border transfer (s.48 to s.50).
In this repository a static synthetic fixture: fixtures/dpa/triage_messages.jsonl. Swept by dpa/retention_sweeper.py.

categories.access: No API route returns stored messages. QA store: dpo role via dpa/rights_lookup.py
protection: never written to logs: the audit line holds a keyed hash of the redacted text (security/redact_then_hash.py)
injection guard before any model call (security/injection_guard.py)

categories.what: Who did what: staff usernames and roles, JWT claims, request/trace ids, routing keys (device ids)
categories.purpose: Authentication, authorisation, accountability for each decision
categories.lawful_basis_teaching_label: TEACHING LABEL (legal review pending): employment / service contract with staff and legitimate interest in securing a health service

where.note: 30-minute lifetime; never logged (tests/test_audit_logging.py checks every log file)
demo users with bcrypt hashes only; an identity provider in production

categories.patient_identifiers: None are collected by design: no name, no national ID, no phone. If a CHW types one into a message, redact_then_hash.py removes it before anything is logged, and the redaction count shows it happened.
protection: JWT with pinned HS256, issuer and audience (afyaplus/auth.py)

categories.what: Tool calls to the logistics MCP server: county, service, clinic_id, stock item, and the caller
data_subjects: the calling staff member (linked by actor)
categories.personal_data: yes, only through the actor field; the arguments themselves are facility data
categories.purpose: Find a clinic and check stock for a referral; detect enumeration attempts
categories.lawful_basis_teaching_label: TEACHING LABEL (legal review pending): legitimate interest in running and securing the referral service

where.note: operational log; arguments pass through the redactor
audit line with HMAC of the arguments, not the arguments
counts and latencies only, no actor

categories.access: clinics_allowlist.json limits what each caller can see; security/rbac.py limits who can call

categories.what: One line per security decision: actor, role, action, resource, outcome, trace_id, keyed hash of the redacted payload
categories.sensitive: no: payload text is never stored, only an HMAC of its redacted form
categories.purpose: Security monitoring, incident investigation, evidence for access and erasure requests
categories.lawful_basis_teaching_label: TEACHING LABEL (legal review pending): legitimate interest / legal obligation to keep data secure (s.41)

where.location: logs/audit.jsonl and logs/audit_mcp.jsonl on the triage-logs volume
where.note: hash-chained; archived files encrypted with security/encrypt_at_rest.py

categories.what: Operational JSON lines: method, path, status, latency, urgency, prompt version, token counts
categories.purpose: Operations, cost and canary decisions (Weeks 7 and 8)
categories.lawful_basis_teaching_label: TEACHING LABEL (legal review pending): legitimate interest in operating the service

where.note: every extra field passes through the redactor (afyaplus/logging_setup.py)

categories.what: Clinic registry (facility names, facility phone numbers, stock), synthetic golden set, prompts, configuration, metrics, deletion records
categories.note: Facility phone numbers belong to institutions. evals/golden.jsonl and fixtures/ are synthetic. dpa/deletion_records.jsonl holds hashed record ids and counts only.

transfers_outside_kenya.safeguards_needed: s.48 to s.50 conditions (adequate safeguards / appropriate contract) to be confirmed in legal review; until then the default backend is replay (no transfer)

transfers_outside_kenya.to: Azure South Africa North / AWS af-south-1
transfers_outside_kenya.when: if the Key Vault / KMS design in security/kms_twin.json is built

breach_notification: Notify the Data Commissioner within 72 hours of becoming aware of a breach (s.43); runbook owner named in dpa/rights_process.md
